text:
inc-bot: 🚨 PROBLEM: spike in 5xx + kv-cache pressure detected across us-west-2 inference fleet. metric: kv_cache_oom_rate ↑ 430% in last 3m. sample alert: /alerts/1872349999
ryan_oncall: on it. paging to runtime and SRE. tagging @maria_runtime @sam_sre
maria_runtime: thanks — looking at traces, seems correlated with tool calls that return structured output (json arrays). continuous-batcher is creating very large shards, evicting prefix entries. I see repeated `batch_size=1` fallbacks for those requests and huge KV churn.
sam_sre: are customers impacted? any external 5xx errors?
ella_support: support stack shows a handful of high-latency errors for CustomerX and CustomerY, timeouts in our SDKs. Customers reporting timeouts ~3m ago.
ryan_oncall: initial impact: higher p99 latency and some 502s. marking incident P1 and starting handoff. ryan_oncall -> sam_sre.
maria_runtime: hypothesis: structured tool outputs are hitting continuous-batcher key normalization. Structured outputs often vary length, causing KV cache key fragmentation and prefetch to stampede. We need to stop prefetch for funcall responses and reduce batch window to avoid creating huge KV segments.
sam_sre: agree. proposed mitigations: 1) toggle `runtime.prefetch.enabled=false` for the affected shardset; 2) apply batch-window throttle to 10ms; 3) temporarily disable toolcall-prefetch routing rule. Which is fastest?
maria_runtime: toggle prefetch is fastest. I can push a config change to the control plane for us-west-2 dedicated pools. Will also prepare a hotfix to make the batcher ignore `structured_output` features for batching keys.
deploy-bot: request received: config change `runtime.prefetch.enabled` -> false in prod/us-west-2. awaiting approval.
ryan_oncall: approved. deploy-bot please proceed. @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: applying change to /configs/runtime/us-west-2: runtime.prefetch.enabled=false (canary 5%)
maria_runtime: canary looks good, no increase in errors. ramping to 50% now.
deploy-bot: ramp to 50% complete.
sam_sre: I'm opening a temporary rate-limit rule to prevent batcher from accepting > 600 concurrent prefetch ops per node.
ella_support: telling CustomerX we're investigating and applying mitigations; ETA ~10min.
maria_runtime: while prefetch toggle is running, I'm preparing a one-line hotfix for the batcher key-generation: ignore `funcall.structured_output` fields when computing cache key. will push a job to runtime-configs. snippet:```json
{
  "key_policy": {
    "ignore_fields": ["funcall.structured_output", "tools.response.schema"]
  }
}
```
ryan_oncall: that looks safe as a short-term stopgap. Maria, can you validate no correctness regressions?
maria_runtime: yes, tests pass for model-call integrity; producer tests show no drop in output fidelity for sampled prompts. still running larger regression suite.
deploy-bot: hotfix config deploy started to runtime-configs (canary).
maria_runtime: canary hotfix OK. ramping to full.
deploy-bot: hotfix deployed to 100% in us-west-2.
sam_sre: seeing kv_cache_oom_rate drop ~70% in last 3m. 5xxs falling back to baseline. p99 latency improving.
ella_support: CustomerX confirmation: timeouts resolved. CustomerY still seeing occasional 502s — looks like client-side retries that hit in-flight capacity.
ryan_oncall: fine, let's add a short client guidance note: reduce aggressive retries for 30m window, we'll monitor. Ella, can you post to customers?
ella_support: posted: "We've applied runtime config changes to mitigate tool-call induced cache churn. Please hold heavy retry loops for 30 minutes while the system stabilizes."
maria_runtime: follow-up: we also disabled continuous prefetch for funcalls only, not general prefetch. I'll open a PR for a more robust keying strategy (semantic hashing + size cap) and a test harness to surface structured-output variance.
sam_sre: I'll keep the rate-limit rule active for 1 hour, then handoff to capacity-ops if stable. Also creating a pager ticket for infra to review eviction settings.
ryan_oncall: status update: incident moved to Mitigated. root-cause suspected: batch key fragmentation due to structured toolcall outputs causing excessive KV churn + prefetch stampede. action items assigned.
maria_runtime: assigned postmortem ownership to @maria_runtime, SRE review assigned to @sam_sre. ETA for postmortem draft: 48h.
ella_support: logging customer impact counts: CustomerX (partial degraded calls, ~12 requests failed), CustomerY (~28 timeouts), internal monitoring spike flagged 2.5% error-rate bump for ~11 min.
ryan_oncall: thanks all. I'll close once postmortem link and follow-up tasks created. good job on quick rollback and hotfix. :tada:
sam_sre: quick note for follow-up: add test case in chaos harness that generates varied structured tool outputs to simulate KV key fragmentation.
maria_runtime: adding to backlog and will prioritize the PR.
inc-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: Mitigated -> Creating incident record at /incidents/1872349999; severity=P1; mitigated_by=[runtime.prefetch toggle, batcher key hotfix]; owners=[maria_runtime, sam_sre]; postmortem_due=48h
ryan_oncall: closing the active page. if anyone sees a regression re-open this thread.
ella_support: ack.
sam_sre: ack.
maria_runtime: ack.
